strategy.angle: The shift from digital AI to Physical AI as the next critical industrial pivot.
strategy.audience: Houston business leaders, industrial operators, and technology executives.

draft.hook: Your company’s data infrastructure is about to face the ultimate stress test: the transition from virtual workflows to physical autonomy.
draft.body:
NVIDIA’s recent pivot toward a multi-layered safety architecture for 'Physical AI' isn't just about robots—it’s the definitive blueprint for mass-scale industrial automation by 2035. As we move from R&D to deployment, we are crossing a high-stakes threshold where AI failure no longer results in a software error, but in physical liability. In Houston’s industrial sector, where precision is measured in capital risk, failing to integrate standardized safety protocols now will lead to uninsurable operations later. 

Why does this matter for the C-suite today? Because safety is no longer a peripheral compliance issue; it is a competitive barrier to entry.
